comparison.objective: Sort bolts so exactly five grey bolts enter a flight-kit tray and all remaining bolts enter a spares tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated bolt picking, counting, classification, and tray placement, not coaxial mandrel insertion or controlled hammer fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly five grey bolts in the white kit tray and all others in the black tray; no finer placement or damage rubric is provided.
comparison.reason: Although both involve small metal items and containment, this tests counting and sorting pre-existing objects, not creating and recovering four fragments while protecting retained inserts.
